entities.summary: Ernest Leslie Dickens was a Canadian two-sport athlete from Manitoba. He played soccer for Winnipeg United Weston and then enjoyed a career as an ice hockey defenceman in the National Hockey League (NHL), playing with the Toronto Maple Leafs and Chicago Black Hawks between 1942 and 1951.
